name: Boast
overview: Scripture teaches that true boasting is reserved for the Lord alone, as the psalmist declares a soul’s boast in God brings gladness to the humble and continual praise. Human wisdom, strength, or riches are not grounds for glory, as the Lord commands us not to boast in these earthly attributes. Salvation is a gift of God’s grace received through faith, underscoring that any boast must be rooted in the unmerited favor of God rather than personal achievement.
